convert.pickToStart: Pick a file from the home screen to get started.
convert.gpsFound: Location data found. It will be removed from the converted file.
convert.claimedMismatch: This file is named as {{claimed}} but its contents are {{actual}}. Converting the real format.
convert.willFlatten: {{format}} has no transparency, so transparent areas become white.
convert.grewExplanation: {{source}} compresses this image better than {{target}} can. The conversion is still correct. Lower the quality if size matters more than fidelity, or keep the original.

batch.notificationsOff: Notifications are off, so this won’t appear in your shade. It still finishes if you leave the app.
batch.stopped_one: Stopped. The {{count}} file already converted is below. The rest were left alone.
batch.stopped_other: Stopped. The {{count}} files already converted are below. The rest were left alone.

options.title: Options
options.aimForSizeHint: Searches for the quality that lands just under your limit

metadataHint.keepExceptGps: Camera and date survive. Where you were does not.
metadataHint.keepAll: Everything is carried over, including location.

options.convertToSrgbHint: Wide-gamut photos look over-saturated in apps that ignore the profile
options.backgroundHint: {{format}} has no transparency. Transparent areas become this colour.
options.namesKept: Names are kept as they are
options.wouldCollide: Every file would get the same name. Add {name} or {index}.

name.label: Name
name.detail: The original name, without its extension

original.label: Original
original.detail: Keep the size it already is

email.label: Email
email.detail: Under 1 MB, fits any attachment limit

options.presetsEmpty: Save these options to reuse them without rebuilding them.

pdf.lockedHint: The password is used to open the file and is never saved, sent, or written anywhere.
pdf.wrongPassword: That password did not open it.
pdf.pagesHint: Leave it empty for every page, or write something like 1-3, 7, 9-
pdf.rangeMatchesNothing: That range does not match any pages
pdf.pngLossless: PNG is lossless, so there is no quality to choose. Larger files, exact pixels.
pdf.orderHint: Documents are joined in the order you picked them.
pdf.rangesHint: Each range becomes its own document
pdf.flattensBody: Every page is redrawn as an image, so the result cannot be selected, searched, or read aloud. Neither platform can shrink a PDF without doing this. Keep the original if any of that matters.
pdf.grayscaleHint: Halves the size of a scanned document at no readable cost

fit.label: Fit image
fit.detail: Each page takes the shape of its image

letter.label: Letter
letter.detail: The standard in the US and Canada

fit.label: Fit
fit.hint: The whole image, with space around it where the shapes differ

fill.label: Fill
fill.hint: Fills the page and crops what does not fit

stretch.label: Stretch
stretch.hint: Fills the page by distorting the image

incoming.title: Sent here
incoming.whatToDo: What would you like to do?
incoming.unreadable_one: {{count}} file could not be identified and will be left out.
incoming.unreadable_other: {{count}} files could not be identified and will be left out.
incoming.nothingUsableBody: These files are not in a format this app reads. Images and PDFs both work.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Conversions you run will be listed here, on this device. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared.
history.entryHint: Shows the file names and lets you remove this entry

errors.unreadable: This file could not be opened. It may have been moved or deleted since you picked it.
errors.unsupportedSource: This format is not supported on this device. Older Android versions cannot read HEIC.
errors.unsupportedTarget: This device cannot write that format. Choose a different output format.
errors.corrupt: This file is damaged or incomplete, so it cannot be read. Try downloading it again.
errors.outOfMemory: This image is too large to process right now. Close other apps and try again.
errors.diskFull: There is not enough free space to save the result. Free up some space and try again.
errors.permissionDenied: Saving needs permission to add photos. You can grant it in Settings.
errors.passwordRequired: This PDF is password protected. Enter its password to continue.
errors.wrongPassword: That password did not work. Check it and try again.
errors.downloadFailed: This file is stored in the cloud and could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong converting this file. Try again.

notification.channelDescription: Shows how far a batch has got while the app is in the background.

share.unreadable: Those files could not be read.
share.pdfFailed: That PDF could not be made.
share.photosDenied: Converted. Saving to Photos was not allowed.

permissions.photoLibraryAdd: {{app}} saves your converted images straight to your photo library. It never reads your library. You choose files through the system picker.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHint: Only the app changes. A photo converted in dark mode does not come out dark. The fill behind a transparent image is a separate setting, and it never follows this one.
settings.languageHint: Kitefold speaks {{count}} languages and follows the one your device is set to. There is no picker here because your phone already has one, and unlike this screen it can restart the app, which is what switching to or from a right-to-left language needs.
settings.madeBy: Made by Owais Khan. No team, no investors, and no analytics, so there is no way for me to know whether anyone has read this.
settings.privacy: No trackers, no accounts, nothing leaving this device. That is not a promise in a policy. The release build ships without the internet permission, so the system enforces it rather than trusting the code.
